statement: Clipboard reads and terminal-originated writes requiring Ghostty consent do not complete until the user approves the exact reviewed text; missing window, unsupported MIME/shape, or denial does not grant access. The approved payload is copied before the asynchronous sheet and the clipboard is not reread afterward.
consequence: Without this boundary, terminal programs could silently read private clipboard text or overwrite clipboard contents, or the user could approve different content than the data later sent.

enforcedAt.trigger: Ghostty requests a clipboard read/write callback
